highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m153.
highlights_body: Linux applications that rely on fontconfig fallback may select a different face after upgrading; use an explicit or bundled typeface when selection must be deterministic.

breaking.title: Linux font fallback may choose a different face
breaking.body: Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path, which can change text metrics or glyph selection. Specify the family and style explicitly, or use a bundled typeface, when deterministic fallback is required.

bullets.detail: Aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 153 and incorporates its upstream bug fixes.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Preview 1 opened the 4.153 line with the Skia m153 engine update.
preview_summaries.v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2: Release Candidate 1 finalized the 4.153 preview line.

v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m153 engine update.
v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.body: Linux font fallback can select a different face; applications requiring deterministic selection should specify or bundle a typeface.

v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Release Candidate 1 finalizes the m153 preview line.
